pillars.tldr: Hospitality is a community, and FireFlair brings it together: bartenders, waiters, event staff and the businesses that hire them. Reputation travels with people on FireFlair, so you hire with confidence. Choose staff your colleagues already trust and build a bench you can call on all year.

seo.title: Hire Hospitality Staff You Can Trust | FF Staff
seo.description: Meet featured staff, book whole teams and read reviews from other businesses on FF Staff.

card.d: Bartenders, waiters and event staff to book.

p: Featured staff are bartenders, waiters and event staff with strong profiles and reviews. Browse them and see who they work with.
Everyone shares the same values: be reliable, be kind, and make every event a night worth remembering. Find the people who work that way and keep them close.
Every profile shows skills, experience and reviews, so you know who you are booking before you ask.

seo.title: Meet the featured staff | FF Staff
seo.description: Bartenders, waiters and event staff to book.

card.d: Companies with teams ready to hire together.

sections.h: Book a team, not just a person
p: Companies on FireFlair bring teams that are ready to work together. Book the whole team in one go, rather than person by person.
Book someone and see their network. Add the people they work with to the same event, so teams that work well together stay together.
Book a company, then choose from its team.

seo.title: Book a team, not just a person | FF Staff
seo.description: Companies with teams ready to hire together.

p: Reviews come from other businesses that have hired the same people, so you can book with confidence.
Every review shows on their profile. After each shift you review them, and they review you.
Choose staff your colleagues already trust and build a bench you can call on all year.

pillars.tldr: Your Company Card tells everyone you hire who you are, what you do and who is on your team. Share it with a link, send it with every booking and let your professionalism show before the first message.

seo.title: Create Your Company Card | FF Staff
seo.description: Build a Company Card, set up your company and your team, and find the right people for every event.

p: Your Company Card is what everyone you hire sees first. It says who you are, what you do and who is on your team.
It is sent to anyone you hire, to show them who you are. It can also be added to FF Party to advertise your services.
A strong Company Card wins the trust of the best people before you have said a word. Keep it fresh, add your team and let your reputation do the recruiting.
